justification: A depicts a naturalistic bearded human head in profile with elaborately patterned hair, beard, headdress and an earring, carved in modelled relief, while B shows only sparse scratched abstract lines, crosshatched lozenges, small circles and rows of angular sign-like strokes with no figural content.
